categories.main_business_segments: Dirui Medical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical device industry, focusing on in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instruments and related reagents. Its product portfolio includes seven major series: urine analysis, biochemical analysis, chemiluminescence immunoassay, gynecological secretion analysis, blood cell analysis, coagulation analysis, and integrated laboratory systems. The company develops, manufactures, markets, and services these diagnostic instruments and consumables used for clinical testing and disease diagnosis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as automatic focusing, fuzzy logic anti-interference algorithms, planar flow cytometry, precision dosing mechanisms, high-precision laser shaping and scattering light collection, and flow imaging technologies. It emphasizes modular production for instruments and quality control in reagent manufacturing. AI and deep learning, including convolutional neural networks and transfer learning, are applied to enhance diagnostic accuracy, especially in urine sediment analysis. The company also integrates multi-modal AI algorithms for comprehensive diagnostic support.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dirui serves hospitals, clinical laboratories, and healthcare institutions, including large public hospitals and community healthcare centers. Its products are used for routine health check-ups and disease auxiliary diagnosis, covering diseases such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, liver and kidney diseases, tumors, infections, and gynecological conditions. The company’s products are distributed domestically across China and internationally to approximately 125 countries and regions, targeting both emerging and developed markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities in Changchun. It has a significant international presence with subsidiaries and localized production in countries including India, Russia, Turkey, Thailand, Indonesia, Colombia, the Netherlands, and Hong Kong. The international market accounts for about 32% of revenue, with focused marketing and local production efforts in key countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dirui operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It is engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic instruments and reagents, supplying end-users such as hospitals and laboratories. The company also manages procurement of raw materials and components, emphasizing supplier collaboration and increasing localization of inputs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent diagnostics, automation, and digitalization of laboratory systems. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on upgrading existing product lines and developing new instruments such as fully automated coagulation analyzers and modular blood cell analysis systems. AI-driven diagnostic algorithms and multi-modal data integration are key R&D themes. Dirui also emphasizes patent protection and continuous product iteration to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Dirui generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical diagnostic instruments and consumable reagents. The sales model is predominantly distributor-based complemented by direct sales. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, with domestic sales confirmed upon customer receipt and international sales recognized based on shipping terms. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dirui is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in China's IVD market, with a comprehensive product portfolio covering over 80% of clinical testing items. It competes with both domestic and international medical device companies, leveraging cost-effectiveness, technological innovation, and extensive product lines. The company benefits from national policies favoring domestic substitution and has a strong foothold in both high-end and community healthcare segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dirui reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a decrease of 11.63% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 141.9 million, down 48.5%. The company experienced challenges including macroeconomic pressures, intensified procurement policies, and delayed customer payments impacting cash flow. Despite short-term declines, Dirui maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 3.1 billion and continues to invest over 10% of revenue in R&D to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dirui emphasizes its fully independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product range, and high cost-performance ratio as key differentiators. Its products integrate advanced AI and automation technologies to improve diagnostic accuracy and laboratory efficiency. The company’s commitment to quality management, international certifications, and localized production supports reliable supply and competitive pricing. Dirui’s strategic alignment with national healthcare policies and focus on intelligent, integrated diagnostic solutions position it as a trusted partner in clinical diagnostics.
